package main
import (
 "fmt"
 "os"
 "strings"
 "github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/shim/ast"
 "github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/shim/core"
 "github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/shim/parser"
 "github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/shim/tspath"
 "github.com/system-inc/cohere/internal/lint/rule"
)
func main() {
 data,err:=os.ReadFile(os.Args[1]);if err!=nil {panic(err)}
 count:=0
 for _,row:=range strings.Split(string(data),"\n") {
  if row=="" {continue};path:=strings.Split(row,"\t")[0]
  source,err:=os.ReadFile(path);if err!=nil {panic(err)}
  file:=parser.ParseSourceFile(ast.SourceFileParseOptions{FileName:path,Path:tspath.Path(path)},string(source),core.ScriptKindTSX)
  id,message:="",""
  listener:=oracleGoogleFontDisplay().Run(rule.Context{SourceFile:file,FileCache:rule.NewFileCache(),Report:func(d rule.Diagnostic){id=d.Message.Id;message=d.Message.Description;count++}},nil)
  var walk func(*ast.Node);walk=func(n *ast.Node){if visit:=listener[n.Kind];visit!=nil{visit(n)};n.ForEachChild(func(child *ast.Node)bool{walk(child);return false})};walk(file.AsNode())
  if len(os.Args)<3 {fmt.Printf("%s\t%s\n",id,message)}
 }
 if len(os.Args)>2 {fmt.Println(count)}
}
